title: EB-NeRD reranker inputs for A2 test inference
subtitle: ebnerd_small and ebnerd_testset parquets the locked reranker reads
description: Private dataset for CS4.406 A2 (CONTEXT.md C-036). Exactly the parquet files src/rerank/ebnerd.py opens for test-set inference with src/rerank/config.FINAL: ebnerd_small/{train,validation}/{behaviors,history}.parquet (stage-1 indexes and the fit sample) and ebnerd_testset/{articles.parquet,test/{behaviors,history}.parquet}. __MACOSX and .DS_Store are excluded; no entity/relation embeddings, which the reranker never reads. sha256 of each member is in scripts/kaggle/ebnerd_test_dataset/SHA256SUMS in the repo.
